decisions.reason: The black-finish line is a multi-model design range close to the core offer and fits the announced design-led direction, so the sunk investment favours keeping it, although its low website visibility makes it somewhat more vulnerable.
The shower channel for seamless coverings has its own page and is central to the publicly announced barrier-free bathroom strategy, so commitment strongly favours persisting.
The tileable floor drain sits next to the core offer, is prominently presented on its own page and costs little to keep, so management stays with it.
The stainless steel design grate embodies the firm's design-and-engineering positioning and is visibly committed on its own page, so it is kept.

Having just launched the pump-drain shower channel as the successor to the withdrawn pump line, management has publicly recommitted to pump-assisted drainage and would attribute weak early results to its newness rather than drop it.
